lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's one hundred fifty? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's $150? Nope!

lines.text: If Ali gives twenty percent to Bea, they're equal.
lines.caption: If Ali gives 20% to Bea, they're equal.

lines.text: If Bea gives Ali ten dollars instead, Ali has double. How much in all?
lines.caption: If Bea gives Ali $10 instead, Ali has double. How much in all?

lines.text: Twenty percent is one fifth: five parts for Ali.
lines.caption: 20% is 1/5: 5 parts for Ali.

lines.text: He gives one. Both have four, so Bea started with three.
lines.caption: He gives one. Both have 4, so Bea started with 3.

lines.text: Then Bea gives ten. Twice her money is six parts, minus twenty.
lines.caption: Then Bea gives $10. Twice her money is 6 parts, minus 20.

lines.text: Ali has five parts plus ten. So one part is thirty!
lines.caption: Ali has 5 parts plus 10. So one part is $30!

lines.text: Eight parts of thirty: two hundred forty dollars!
lines.caption: 8 parts of $30: $240!

lines.text: One hundred fifty was the trap. That's just Ali.
lines.caption: $150 was the trap. That's just Ali.

lines.text: Did you get two hundred forty? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get $240? Tell me below!
